sectionNotes.parking: These minimums are reduced by 10% because the site is within 0.25 mi of the Addison Transit Center

notes: Development must follow the site plan, landscape plan, floor plan and building elevations in Exhibit B.
No residential use is allowed within the 65 LDN airport noise contour.
Along Edwin Lewis Drive, the building must be at least 3 ft from the edge of the sidewalk.
The second floor must be built so it can later become a parking garage, and the parking lift to the second floor must meet the Fire Code.

The site plan shows a 78 ft building (to the mechanical screening), 5 stories, 40% lot coverage, and 44 parking spaces required with 45 provided: 23 in the garage, 18 on the surface and 5 on the street.

history.004-048: Rezoned 2.8 acres at 4960 Arapaho from C-1 to a PD with restaurant permits
history.023-39: Restated PD 020-53 to allow one fifth-floor dwelling in a 5-story commercial building

curtisNotes: One Addison Place PD was originally based on the legacy Urban Center (UC) district. UC was replaced by M-4 so some things might be different from the original plan. This PD also used the transit center's 10% minimum parking reduction (provided: 45 space, required: 49 - 5 = 44), I'm unsure if it's now non-coforming or if the 10% reduction stays with the PD.
